item.title: Toptal: Cryptography Specialist for AI lab
item.description:
Headquarters:

Overview

A fast-growing AI evaluation company is building expert-level benchmarks that test how well AI agents handle real professional work in the terminal. We are hiring cryptography experts to turn real, paid tasks from their own work into end-to-end challenges for AI agents, each with a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench cryptography tasks by turning real, paid work from your own experience into challenges that an AI agent must solve end to end.

• Define the task environment, including files, systems, ciphertexts and data, so the challenge is realistic, self-contained and reproducible in a Linux command-line setup.

• Write a working reference solution in Python or SageMath that proves the task is solvable, for example by recovering a key or decrypting a secret.

• Build automated checks and tests that objectively verify the final result is correct, and explain how a mistake or a partial answer would be detected.

• Calibrate task difficulty so a typical expert needs about 60-75 minutes to solve it, keeping it hard for AI agents while still fair and unambiguous.

• Package each task with Docker and Git where applicable, document instructions clearly, and revise based on reviewer feedback until it meets the required quality bar.

Skills/Experience

• 3+ years of hands-on cryptanalysis or applied cryptography; GRC, audit-only, policy, sales or management roles do not count, nor does coursework only

• Did the work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

• Uses the low-level tools of the subfield, such as SageMath and Python, and works comfortably on the Linux command line

• Can show how a finding is proven, such as a decrypted secret or a recovered key, and explain how a mistake would be caught

• Technical fluency with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

• Available to start around November 2026

Nice-to-have

• Published write-ups or research on cryptanalysis

• Strong CTF results, especially in crypto categories

• CVEs discovered in cryptographic implementations

• Experience with Docker, Git and writing automated tests

• Proficiency in C for low-level cryptographic work

Process

• Task vetting: complete a vetting task instead of a live interview

• Work is paid per task, with each task taking roughly 60-75 minutes

• Expected start around early November 2026

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cryptography-specialist-for-ai-lab

item.title: DRFIRST COM INC: Senior Software Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=fc2a6c7e-ef54-4ed9-8c04-d5aca23f99e3

Senior Software Engineer, eRx Enterprise and Gadget

About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you’ll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

DrFirst is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the eRx Enterprise and Gadget team. Your first focus is Gadget, our pharmacy agent. Over time you will extend your work into Rcopia, our ePrescribing platform, on Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) and Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) workflows.

You will build cloud native, high performance services for an ePrescribing collaboration platform. The platform connects providers, patients, payers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical companies in real time. You will design systems built for high load, with self healing, auto scaling, and full observability.

You bring strong judgment about AI. You know when AI speeds up delivery and when AI produces weak code. You apply AI to raise code quality, performance, and design standards across the team, and you solve real problems for the pharmacies and prescribers who rely on our platform.

What You Will Work On

  • Build and improve Gadget, the DrFirst pharmacy agent, from design through production.
  • Contribute to Rcopia EPCS and PDMP capabilities as the team roadmap expands.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable Java integration solutions.
  • Build cloud native microservices on AWS with auto scaling, fault tolerance, high availability, and self healing.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with major EHR platforms, including athenaOne, Epic, Oracle Health, Greenway, AdvancedMD, eMDs, and ModMed, using HL7, FHIR, web services, APIs, and Mirth Connect.
  • Build and maintain event driven architectures with Apache Kafka for reliable, efficient service communication.
  • Deliver high throughput and low latency across large, distributed platforms.
  • Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Design AI powered automation frameworks for faster development cycles and automated regression testing.
  • Decide where AI adds value in the codebase and where human design must lead. Set review standards for AI assisted code.
  • Monitor, diagnose, and resolve performance issues with observability tools and logs.
  • Follow and enforce secure coding practices. Take part in security audits and reviews.
  • Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.
  • Track industry trends and improve system performance, resilience, and developer productivity.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands on Java development with deep knowledge of object oriented design and the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
  • 3+ years designing and building cloud native applications on AWS, including S3, Valkey, Lambda, RDS, and EKS or ECS.
  • 3+ years with distributed messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, with a solid grasp of event streaming.
  • Proven record building and integrating large scale, high performance, distributed systems with fault tolerance, scalability, and low latency.
  • AI first mindset, with daily hands on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
  • Clear judgment on when and where AI improves engineering outcomes, and a record of keeping AI generated code from lowering quality, performance, or design.
  • Proficiency building and consuming RESTful APIs with JSON and XML.
  • Strong experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.
  • Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.
  • Solid knowledge of application and data security, including authentication, authorization, and data protection.
  • Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.
  • Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proactive, solution oriented approach.

Preferred

  • Experience building AI agents, LLM integrations, or agentic workflows in production.
  • Experience with large scale, mission critical systems in finance, brokerage, trading, or credit card processing, especially systems requiring low latency, high throughput, and high availability.
  • Experience with ePrescribing, EPCS, PDMP, NCPDP SCRIPT, or pharmacy systems.
  • Familiarity with front end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

Physical Requirements

  • Primarily desk work in a remote, U.S. based setting.
  • Extended periods of computer use.

#LI-GF1 #LI-Remote

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, with a base salary of $130,000 to $150,000 (Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience)
  • Eligible for a Discretionary Performance-based bonus
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K eligible after 3 months of employment, with 50% company match up to first 5% of salary contributed to the plan with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • HSA for eligible employees enrolled in the HDHP, with a generous company contribution up to $500 for individual coverage and $1000 for family coverage per year
  • 100% company paid short and long-term disability, AD&D, and group life insurance
  • Accrued annual paid time off (PTO) of 18 days for the first 3 years of service, increasing thereafter and 7 paid holiday days
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Continuing Education funds up to $1500 annually for eligible programs after 1 year of service
  • Voluntary benefits including FSA, Hospital indemnity, Accident and Critical Illness insurances


DrFirst is committed to being a Remote-First company, creating a dynamic and flexible workplace where everyone thrives, no matter where they log in from. Check out our approach to remote work: https://drfirst.com/company/about-us/careers/

Our recruitment process at DrFirst is straightforward and secure. You will only be contacted by our recruitment team through an official @drfirst.com email address. We will never ask you for payment or sensitive personal information, such as your social security number or banking details, at any stage of the hiring process. If you encounter any communications claiming to be from DrFirst that seem suspicious, please contact our recruitment team directly at contato@exemplo.invalid to verify the message’s authenticity. Your security is important to us!

item.title: Toptal: ML Inference Engineer – Terminal-Bench Task Designer
item.description:
Headquarters:

Overview

We are building a benchmark that tests how well AI agents handle real expert work in a terminal. We are hiring ML inference and serving experts to turn real, paid tasks from their jobs into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the environment, a working solution, and an automated check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks that turn real, paid ML inference work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

• Define the files, systems and environments each task runs on, such as model serving with streaming, so the challenge is realistic, reproducible and command-line solvable.

• Write a working reference solution for every task and verify it runs end to end, sized for about 60 to 75 minutes of expert effort.

• Build automated checks that objectively prove a result is correct, including cases where ML outputs go wrong silently, such as numerical drift or metric bugs.

• Did this work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

• Trained, served or evaluated models at real scale (multi-GPU or production serving), not only notebooks or API calls

• Hands-on with PyTorch or JAX internals and serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM

• Can explain how ML results go wrong without errors (numerical drift, metric bugs) and how to catch them

• Technical fluency in Python and the command line, and with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

Nice-to-have

The Quantum Research Scientist will advance quantum information science and optical quantum systems, leveraging expertise in continuous-variable photonics and theoretical algorithm discovery to translate complex physical phenomena into experimental prototypes and publishable research.

item.title: Custom Mechanical Solutions: Quality and Reliability Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://cmswa.com

Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress.

If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact.  We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team.

About Custom Mechanical Solutions

Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support.

As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization.

Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer
Department: CMS National Accounts
Location: Fully remote within the United States
Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel

Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes.

Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales.

The opportunity

CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects.

Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions.

What you will own

  • Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure.
  • Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation.
  • Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence.
  • Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed.
  • Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners.
  • Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness.

You will probably love this role if...

  • When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer.
  • You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly.
  • You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed.
  • You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved.
  • You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one.

Required qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support.
  • Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills.
  • Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico.
  • A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience.
  • Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes.
  • Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations.
  • Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards.
  • Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience.
  • This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus.
  • Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms.

Why CMS National Accounts

You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio.

If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you.

Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

item.title: Knock: Lending Manager (Front End) - Remote
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces six times in the past seven years.

We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.  The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness. 

Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating. 

Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit Knock.com

Lending Manager (Front End)

About the role

Knock is looking for an experienced mortgage leader to manage and grow our team of fully remote Loan Assistants. This is a 100% remote role, and you’ll lead a team distributed across the country. You enjoy building teams, finding efficiencies, and using technology to improve how work gets done. You’re approachable, open-minded, and adaptable. You know the work well enough to coach it and you’re willing to jump in and help. In this role you’ll own the Loan Assistant and post-closing pipelines, develop your team, and work with the Director of Lending Operations to make our processes better.

What you’ll do:

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage, lead, and scale the remote Loan Assistant team.
  • Share weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual team and company goals, and make sure the team meets and exceeds expectations.Hold team members accountable for their performance.
  • Build camaraderie and teamwork in a virtual environment through team meetings and regular 1:1 check-ins.
  • Run virtual training for new Loan Assistants and serve as the team’s go-to for escalations, questions, and exceptions.
  • Mentor people inside and outside your team, and keep learning yourself.
  • Document conversations in our HRIS and build a sense of ownership across the team.

Own the pipeline

  • Manage the bridge loan pipeline from setup through initial disclosure and submission, and through post-closing.
  • Coach the team and give feedback along the way.Balance workloads across the team to meet company SLAs.
  • Support post-closing review.
  • Work loans that have findings with the team member responsible and get them resolved.
  • Work closely with Sales, Underwriting, and Closing to give everyone timely, accurate service.
  • Compile team scorecard data each quarter to track KPIs and quality.

Improve how we work

  • Help the Director of Lending Operations find gaps in process and policy across the Loan Assistant and post-closing functions.
  • Write or update procedures for review, training, and rollout, then follow up to make sure the changes stick.
  • Set best practices and change the workflow when needed so the team runs efficiently and meets company KPIs.
  • Take on ad hoc projects and step in wherever your team needs support.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 10 years of relevant mortgage experience, including 5 or more years directly managing a fully remote team
  • Experience managing mortgage loan processing and/or post-closing teams
  • A track record of coaching teams and helping them succeed
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local mortgage regulatory compliance
  • Strong written and virtual communication skills
  • You keep a distributed team aligned, engaged, and accountable using tools like Slack and video meetings
  • A strong focus on customer service. You go above and beyond to “wow” the people you serve.
  • Close attention to detail. You check your work carefully and catch the small things, so your work is consistently accurate.
  • A commitment to diverse, equitable, and inclusive practices that support Knock’s values of making an impact, learning, putting people first, being open, and being courageous
  • High school diploma or equivalent experience

Physical Requirements:

  • Set up and constantly operate a computer
  • Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications

The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated.  Please note that the salary range information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act for Colorado applicants.

The salary range estimate for this position is: $90,000 - $100,000 + company incentive plan (bonus) USD.

This job opening expires December 31, 2026.

Offer & Employment Terms

The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package & benefits, will be at the company’s sole discretion, and determined by factors including but not limited to years of experience, job level, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. The company also reserves the right to amend or modify this job description, employee perks, and benefits at any time. Employees eligible for bonus and/or commission will be provided details in the offer letter.

Why Knock

Purpose-Driven Work: Your contributions will improve the homeownership journey for thousands of individuals and families.
Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a flexible, people-first approach.
Innovative Culture: Collaborate with curious, talented colleagues in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. To learn more about the culture at Knock, view our POPSICLE values.
Commitment to Inclusion: We are dedicated to creating diverse teams and an inclusive, respectful culture where everyone belongs.

Enjoying Life & Making an Impact

Since our founding in 2015, Knock has and continues to offer a 100% remote work culture
 Top tier medical, dental, & vision benefits for full time employees starting on the first day of employment
Flexible Paid Time Off for full time employees
Paid parental leave for all full time employees:
    - 12 weeks paid parental leave for the birthing parent
    - 6 weeks paid parental leave for the non-birthing parent
One thousand annually for professional development
️ Life, AD&D and Disability insurance for full time employees
401K (noncontributory by Knock) for all employees
$75 monthly allowance for health & wellness
Up to $400 monthly for a co-working space for eligible employees
$100 monthly allowance for home internet, mobile phone or other communication devices
$2,500 referral bonus for eligible employees

️ Equal Opportunity Employer

Knock provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable US federal, state, or local laws.

Internal Applicants

If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles.

Remote Culture & Company Mission

We are proud to be a remote, distributed company with employees across 17 states and counting. This is an amazing opportunity to be an integral part of building a multi-billion dollar consumer brand in an industry that is long overdue for a new way of doing things. You will be working with a passionate team that is disrupting the status quo.

Knock, and its subsidiaries, are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
